data.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says

content.basic: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.

data.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them

content.basic: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
